about_the_game:
The original Yooka-Laylee soundtrack beautifully rearranged and with certain tracks recorded together with The City of Prague Philharmonic Orchestra. The Yooka-Replaylee Original Soundtrack also includes brand-new tracks unique to the title.

From the genius minds of David Wise (Donkey Kong Country, Diddy Kong Racing), Grant Kirkhope (Viva Piñata, GoldenEye 007), Steve Burke (Kameo: Elements of Power), Dan Murdoch (Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair) and Matt Griffin (Yooka-Laylee and The Impossible Lair).

Clear out those ears because you want to hear this loud and clear!
